moment_feature: g=mean(x*y) from the independent gate set of 4096 examples. Score each generated I by ||g-P_I g||^2. Return I only; all codebooks and amplitudes initialize independently and never use g as numerical initialization.
moment_fit: 32 fresh starts times 2048 steps; same 65536 updates as static methods. No gradient screening is charged or used by the moment method.
top_two: 32 screening starts times 256 steps, then 14 fresh codebooks for each of the two distinct I with best gate query, 2048 steps each. Retain screening candidates for final selection.
hedged: Same screening, then 14 fresh codebooks for top I and 14 fresh prior proposals with fresh codebooks, each 2048 steps. Retain screening candidates.
cue_negative_control: Absent sets only the low-component amplitude to zero. Directions, strong frequencies, input RNG and fresh initialization RNG match the present condition. Numeric settings stay frozen, so this is a mechanism ablation, not a newly tuned optimizer comparison.
selection_and_evaluation: Gate data and final query remain disjoint; population risk only reports results. No target changes after seeing outcomes.
reason: Declared after the first prospective study found that hard routing helps at frequency 8 but hurts at 6. Test guarded allocations and a theoretically motivated task feature on a separate new cohort, with removal of that feature's signal as a negative control.
